subject: Vendor recertification + capacity uplift — procurement portal checklist
messages:
From: Brightline Procurement <procurement@brightlineanalytics.com>

Cc: carolyn.park@brightlineanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor recertification + capacity uplift for renewal (Brightline)

Hi Nikhil,

We're starting the vendor recertification for our upcoming renewal (end of June). We also plan to increase committed capacity from 200k tokens/month to 500k tokens/month and need the procurement portal updated with the new terms.

Can you do the following by Friday so procurement can start evidence collection?
- Share an updated SOW that reflects the term extension (12 -> 24 months) and capacity uplift.
- Confirm where we should upload SOC2 / data handling evidence in your portal.
- Provide a short list of items procurement will need (e.g., PCI/SOC2 attestation, subprocessor list, DPA).

I've attached a checklist to help (onboarding_evidence_checklist.pdf). Carolyn (cc'd) will be the procurement lead on our side.

Thanks,

Carolyn Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Brightline Analytics
procurement@brightlineanalytics.com

Hi Carolyn — thanks for the heads up. We're ready to move this through. High-level plan:

1) SOW & terms
- I attached a draft SOW (redwood-sow-draft-v2.docx) that includes the 24-month term and the commit increase to 500k tokens/mo. Please scan for line items you need changed.

2) Evidence upload location
- Use our procurement portal: https://portal.redwood.ai/enterprise/brightline/re-certify (I'll request portal access for anyone on your team who doesn't have it).

3) Evidence pack we need from you
- Signed DPA (if changed), SOC2 report, subprocessor list, network diagram (if relevant), and any additional legal/insurance docs. The attached onboarding_evidence_checklist.pdf maps those items to portal sections.

Immediate asks for us:
- Carolyn: can you confirm who should get portal access (list of emails)?
- Procurement: any internal PO/approval windows we should be aware of, and target date for PO issuance?

I'll loop in our renewals lead, Laura, to help with approvals and to accelerate the PO path.

Best,
